title: MUSE: Multi-Tenant Model Serving With Seamless Model Updates
abstract: arXiv:2602.11776v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In binary classification systems, decision thresholds translate model scores into actions. Choosing suitable thresholds relies on the specific distribution of the underlying model scores but also on the specific business decisions of each client using that model. However, retraining models inevitably shifts score distributions, invalidating existing thresholds. In multi-tenant Score-as-a-Service environments, where decision boundaries reside in client-managed infrastructure, this creates a severe bottleneck: recalibration requires coordinating threshold updates across hundreds of clients, consuming excessive human hours and leading to model stagnation. We introduce MUSE, a model serving framework that enables seamless model updates by decoupling model scores from client decision boundaries. translated_title: MUSE：支持无缝模型更新的多租户模型服务框架
translated_abstract: 在二分类系统中，决策阈值将模型分数转化为实际行动。选择合适的阈值既依赖于底层模型分数的具体分布，也依赖于使用该模型的每个客户的具体业务决策。然而，重新训练模型不可避免地会改变分数分布，导致现有阈值失效。在多租户的“分数即服务”环境中，决策边界位于客户自主管理的基础设施中，这造成了一个严重的瓶颈：重新校准需要在数百个客户之间协调阈值更新，消耗大量人工工时并导致模型更新停滞。我们提出了MUSE，这是一个模型服务框架，通过将模型分数与客户决策边界解耦来实现无缝的模型更新。MUSE专为多租户场景设计，通过基于动态意图的路由实现模型共享来优化基础设施复用，并结合两级评分机制……
tldr: MUSE是一个多租户模型服务框架，通过将模型分数与客户端决策边界解耦，使模型更新时无需跨数百个客户重新协调校准阈值，从而实现无缝的模型更新。
en_tdlr: MUSE is a multi-tenant model serving framework that decouples model scores from client-managed decision boundaries, enabling seamless model updates without requiring costly threshold recalibration coordination across hundreds of clients.
